name_zh: 哈萨克斯坦·纳扎尔巴耶夫：核放弃与首都迁移多楔外交
name_en: Kazakhstan Nazarbayev: Nuclear Abandonment & Capital Move Multi-Wedge Diplomacy
description_zh: 努尔苏丹·纳扎尔巴耶夫 (1940-2022) 哈萨克斯坦首任总统 (1990-2019)，继承世界第四大核武库，果断放弃核武器加入不扩散条约，迁都阿斯塔纳(努尔苏丹)，推行多楔外交平衡中俄美欧，建立稳定过渡模式。
description_en: Nursultan Nazarbayev (1940-2022) Kazakhstan first President (1990-2019), inherited world fourth largest nuclear arsenal, decisively abandoned nuclear weapons joined NPT, moved capital to Astana(Nur-Sultan), pursued multi-wedge diplomacy balancing China Russia US EU, established stable transition model.
reason_zh: 纳扎尔巴耶夫代表后苏联核国家无核化与和平权力交接的双重奇迹，展示了中亚大国如何通过核放弃换取国际地位、通过首都迁移重塑国家认同、通过多楔外交实现战略自主。
reason_en: Nazarbayev represents post-Soviet nuclear state denuclearization and peaceful power transition dual miracle, demonstrating how Central Asian great power achieves international status through nuclear abandonment, reshapes national identity through capital move, achieves strategic autonomy through multi-wedge diplomacy.
steps_zh: 研究纳扎尔巴耶夫早年冶金工人与苏共党内晋升
分析1991继承核武库与塞梅帕拉金斯克试验场关闭
探讨1994布达佩斯备忘录核放弃与安全保证
评估1997迁都阿斯塔纳与新首都象征意义
总结多楔外交平衡中俄美欧与2019和平交权托卡耶夫
steps_en: Study Nazarbayev early metallurgist and CPSU rise
Analyze 1991 nuclear arsenal inheritance and Semipalatinsk test site closure
Explore 1994 Budapest Memorandum nuclear abandonment and security assurances
Evaluate 1997 capital move to Astana and new capital symbolic meaning
Summarize multi-wedge diplomacy balancing China Russia US EU and 2019 peaceful handover to Tokayev
expected_zh: 掌握纳扎尔巴耶夫核放弃首都迁移多楔外交三重战略，理解后苏联核国家和平转型范式，评估其对中亚地缘政治稳定的核心贡献。
expected_en: Master Nazarbayev nuclear abandonment capital move multi-wedge diplomacy triple strategy, understand post-Soviet nuclear state peaceful transition paradigm, evaluate its core contribution to Central Asian geopolitical stability.
case_zh: 1991 继承1400枚核弹头；1994 布达佩斯备忘录放弃核武；1997 迁都阿斯塔纳；2019 和平交权。核放弃首都迁移多楔外交范式永存。
case_en: 1991 inherited 1400 nuclear warheads; 1994 Budapest Memorandum abandoned nukes; 1997 moved capital to Astana; 2019 peaceful handover. Nuclear abandonment capital move multi-wedge diplomacy paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Nuclear abandonment model; capital move symbolism; multi-wedge diplomacy; peaceful transition
